name: HD 6569
description: A star 0.76 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses that turns once in 7.13 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

text.card: A star 76% of the Sun's width that turns once in 7.13 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 0.76 solar radii, 0.85 solar masses, a rotation period of 7.13 days and an axis tilted 77° from the line of sight.
